executive_summary.headline: Your presence held with more weight this month, helping the room stay anchored around your pacing and direction.

strategic_interpretation.text: This badge reflects visible control in live moments. Stronger presence is reducing noise, lowering unnecessary explanation, and making your positioning easier to trust.

identity_evolution.text: You are evolving from showing up prepared into showing up with command. The room is responding more to your steadiness than to your volume.

next_month_focus.text: Keep the same calm pressure. Next month should focus on letting that presence carry more of the close without adding extra justification.
